folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B311: donor mechanisms and dated evidence
folds.body:
F1–F5, every prior-evidence row, N1–N5, the pinned Sil-Q sample and ranked dispositions were fully content-reviewed. The important correction survives: not inspected in one pass does not mean never acquired/read; an installed extraction, a complete export, a selected source window, advertised mechanics and actual play are distinct evidence. No present entitlement, installation, price, source availability or missing-path claim was checked here. Newness remains relative to the searched archive. The exact107-line pinned sample is attributed earlier source reading, not a new source read or complete sensory/alertness resolver.

N1–N5 retain separate useful questions: evidence-to-hypothesis-to-action, retained learning versus reset stock, actor-entitled forecasts, context-specific magical competence and distinct light/morale/activation/sensing channels. Donor mechanics do not supply novel laws. A prior author preview is not a character power; a rewind UI is not a universal free undo. A source-qualified exact prediction, broad information channel or reset may legitimately exceed the proposed small case. Likewise, a familiar routine may compress input under AD52 while retaining current-cycle access, costs, elapsed time and changed circumstances; no donor currency or knowledge tax is selected by analogy.

The module names and missing joins are the scout's October31 inspected scope. Later canonical method/paper/recipient delivery and selected lead-route work qualify a broad claim that no evidence/action consumer exists, without proving a general inquiry solver. A current source-qualified operation must be traced on its own inputs. The proposed working-day/week figures are unbenchmarked estimates of a hypothetical bounded slice, not promises, schedules or new completion gates. Keep LOTM-first and selected current priorities; this review selects no Watchmen-style inquiry, MoL reset, Worm power, HP invention or Shadow Slave encounter. No page, manual/PDF, source sample, novel, account or game was fetched or run by this review.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B311: donor mechanisms and dated evidence
folds.body:
F1–F9, the two source-revision boundaries, Roblox scope and proposed F5/F6 pair were fully content-reviewed. Preserve the useful distinctions between temporary binding, permanent transformation, ordinary failure, engine failure and attempted rollback. A recipe matcher must use distinct actual inputs; overlapping eligibility does not authorize double assignment. Exact living Gu, title, controller, body, reserve, location and method decide participant availability and fate. A preview, a cached selection or attempted compensation is not atomic durable settlement. Failed rollback must remain an explicit recovery state rather than silently manufacturing replacements.

Tribulation weights, anti-repeat balancing, battle-refilled energy, victory-based rank and consumptive card fusion are adaptation choices, not novel laws or current OOPS defaults. A preparation affects a sourced event through actual means, not a mandatory random combat penalty. Capacity, energy quality, spendable reserve, upkeep, technique and a host relationship have independent owners. A source-supported combined method may bind, return, injure or consume its participants; no universal combination policy is inferred.

F6/F9's discovery boundary concerns what the character can know, not a ban on attempting unknown experimentation through a supported making method. Actual knowledge, inference, false belief and world truth differ. Existing keeper/novice declarations and mod source observations remain dated source-only evidence; no current native play, license or complete source audit was performed here. Client replication and normal full-copy routes do not establish this task's actual access to any Roblox experience. Preserve source and asset provenance if reuse is later selected; this document grants no outward contact, install or redistribution. The ranked pair remains a proposal for a selected RI lane, with current LOTM/HP order unchanged.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B311: donor mechanisms and dated evidence
folds.body:
F1–F3, P1–P5, D1–D2, C1–C5, all sixteen broader leads and V1–V3/Q1–Q2 were fully content-reviewed. Keep the comparative value in actual joins: teacher willingness versus institutional authority, uncertain translation changing an action, initiating versus triggered costs, an identified interrupted workpiece and a generated visitor with real resources. A donor's documented feature neither establishes our missing seam nor supplies a novel's law. Similar budgets are a comparison aid, not a requirement to equalize powerful starts or methods.

Taiwu/Heaven's Vault/Warsim queued statements and Achra coverage describe the saved October14 intake, not live workers. Roadwarden's earlier discovery and Siralim's non-dispatch correct the roundtrip's framing; they do not invalidate useful mechanics. Vintage Story is additional relative to that supplied inventory, with its version-qualified manual scope. The response's version assertions and sample encounters remain unverified where V2 says so. Medieval Merchants2.0 and the incomplete Idle Loops locator remain incomplete leads; captured response text alone does not establish a source. No signed-in chat response, external page or manual was read anew here.

Retained-workpiece continuation must use actual workpiece identity, remaining material and process state; recovery need not preserve all prior progress if the selected method explicitly resets it. Trigger composition needs current initiating/derived-action attribution and payment order, not generic recursive effects from a shortlist. Uncertain evidence can affect belief and action without silently certifying its truth. Routine queues and interruption should follow actual clocks/support and later AD52 rather than forcing chores to justify automation.

D2's preference for a named missing interaction is a marginal-value recommendation, not an exclusion of deeper Proto23, societies, spatial work or other already authorized scope. Old canon-first wording and research rank do not replace current selected priorities or defer useful original systems. V1's browser submission and current setting claims are historical capture evidence, not permission to send another chat now. No new source acquisition, research roundtrip, installation, implementation, schedule or adopted donor was created by this review.
